text: Billing Dispute Resolution Policy Document ID: Policy_C04_billing_disputes Category: C04 — Billing & Invoices Department: Billing Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Policy Statement Defines the framework for customers to dispute billed charges and the timelines for resolution. Purpose Ensures consistent, compliant, and customer-fair treatment across all channels and customer segments. Scope Applies to all prepaid, postpaid, and (where noted) enterprise customers, and to all NovaTel-authorised channels. Definitions **Customer** — any individual or entity holding an active NovaTel connection or account. **Working day** — a business day excluding weekends and public holidays. Eligibility Applies to customers with an active, KYC-verified account in good standing, subject to the rules and exceptions below. Rules Disputes must be raised within 90 days of the relevant bill's generation date. Standard disputes are targeted for resolution within 5-7 working days; complex usage investigations may take up to 15 working days. Charges under active dispute are not sent to external collections until resolution. Exceptions Enterprise/pooled accounts may follow their signed commercial agreement instead. Approval Requirements Exceptions to standard rules require documented supervisor or department-head approval before being applied. Responsibilities Compliance Requirements This policy is designed to align with applicable regulatory requirements (e.g. TRAI/DoT guidance) as general background context; it is not a substitute for legal advice. Audit Considerations All exceptions and manual overrides must be logged with justification for periodic audit review. Escalation Escalations beyond first-line resolution are logged with a unique ticket reference and routed to the relevant specialist
title: Billing Dispute Resolution Policy
